templates.title: Host a static website
templates.summary: A private S3 bucket served worldwide by CloudFront using Origin Access Control.
templates.costNote: Free tier eligible — typically $0 for a small site.

templates.title: Serverless API
templates.summary: An HTTP API in API Gateway that invokes a Lambda function with a least-privilege role.
templates.costNote: Free tier: 1M Lambda requests and 1M HTTP API calls per month.

templates.title: On-demand DynamoDB table
templates.summary: A pay-per-request table with a partition key and point-in-time recovery.
templates.costNote: On-demand: pay per request; ~$0 when idle.

templates.title: Queue + worker
templates.summary: An SQS queue with a dead-letter queue, drained by a Lambda function.
templates.costNote: Free tier: 1M SQS requests and 1M Lambda requests per month.
